\textbf{Subject: Application for Software Engineering Intern Role}

\vspace{4pt}
Dear Flam Engineering Team,

Flam's mission to push the web beyond static video through sub-300ms, applessly streamed immersive 3D visuals immediately caught my attention. Engineering at the nexus of generative AI models like Fable, Fantom, and Falcon with real-time browser rendering demands meticulous optimization across both the graphics pipeline and client web architecture. As a Computer Science undergraduate with hands-on experience developing modular React frontends, hardware-accelerated WebGL applications, and GenAI systems, I am eager to contribute to your engineering team as a Software Engineering Intern.

My frontend engineering foundation centers on architecting scalable, component-driven web applications that sustain 60fps performance under heavy visual loads. In building Plantera—which secured \textbf{1st place among 120+ teams} at the IEEE DevSpark Hackathon—I architected an interactive spatial visualization platform utilizing React and Mapbox GL's \textbf{hardware-accelerated WebGL rendering pipeline} alongside HTML5 Canvas overlays, ensuring fluid client-side rendering and real-time state synchronization across diverse viewports. Complementing this, as a Web Developer with Students Special Group, I engineered internal management portals using React, Node.js, and MySQL, establishing reusable component libraries and mentoring \textbf{50+ students} in modern JavaScript (ES6+) and frontend design patterns.

Beyond frontend engineering, I bring deep respect for software craftsmanship and generative AI systems. In PatentIQ, I engineered a high-throughput Fastify and Python backend integrating Pinecone vector similarity search with local LLMs (Qwen2.5) for automated patentability analysis. Furthermore, my open-source contribution to \textbf{ESLint Core (PR \#21218)}—where I resolved IEEE 754 floating-point underflow edge cases in AST static analysis backed by \textbf{43 passing automated CI checks}—proves my commitment to writing resilient, production-grade code. While I am actively expanding my scene-graph experience in Three.js, my solid grasp of WebGL rendering contexts, JavaScript engine internals, and \textbf{1200+ solved algorithmic problems} enables me to ramp up rapidly on your real-time 3D streaming stack.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my combined foundation in modular React architecture, WebGL rendering, and GenAI pipelines can help Flam build transformative, low-latency visual experiences for Fortune 500 partners. Thank you for your time and consideration.
